intro: The Side Quarter Pita at CAVA is a complimentary addition to any bowl, offering a warm piece of sprouted wheat pita bread. At just 80 calories, this wholesome side from the [CAVA Sides Menu](/menu/sides) provides the perfect accompaniment to scoop up your favorite [CAVA Dips & Spreads Menu](/menu/dips-spreads) selections. This nutritious pita quarter combines quality ingredients with Mediterranean tradition.
priceCalories: The Side Quarter Pita comes included with your CAVA bowl at no additional charge, making it an excellent value addition. With only 80 calories per serving, it provides a light yet satisfying complement to your meal. For those wanting more, check out the [full CAVA menu](/), where the Whole Pita option is available for $2.25 to $2.55.
whatMakesSpecial: What sets the Side Quarter Pita apart is its sprouted wheat composition, which offers enhanced nutritional benefits compared to regular pita bread. The sprouting process increases nutrient availability and makes the bread easier to digest. Served warm, this complimentary side adds authentic Mediterranean flavor to your [CAVA Curated Bowls Menu](/menu/curated-bowls) selections without overwhelming your meal.
nutritionFacts: Each Side Quarter Pita contains 80 calories with a balanced macronutrient profile of 3g protein, 14g carbohydrates, and 1.5g fat. This light nutritional footprint makes it an ideal addition for those monitoring their calorie intake. The sprouted wheat base provides wholesome energy while keeping the overall nutrition metrics modest and meal-friendly.
whatsInside: The Side Quarter Pita consists of one quarter portion of a warm sprouted wheat pita. Sprouted wheat undergoes a germination process that activates enzymes and breaks down starches, creating a more nutrient-dense bread option. The pita arrives warm, maintaining its soft, pliable texture perfect for scooping or tearing into smaller pieces.
tasteLike: The Side Quarter Pita offers a mild, slightly nutty flavor characteristic of sprouted grains. Its soft, pillowy texture provides a gentle chew with a subtle wheat taste that does not overpower other menu items. The warmth enhances its comforting quality, while the sprouted wheat adds a wholesome depth that pairs beautifully with Mediterranean flavors.
customize: While the Side Quarter Pita comes as a simple, warm bread portion, you can enhance it by pairing it strategically with items from the [CAVA Dips & Spreads Menu](/menu/dips-spreads). Use it to scoop up hummus, tzatziki, or crazy feta for added flavor. You can also request it on the side to control how you incorporate it into your meal experience.
pairsWell: The Side Quarter Pita pairs exceptionally well with all CAVA dips and spreads, especially hummus, tzatziki, and harissa. It complements protein-rich [CAVA Mains Menu](/menu/mains) selections like grilled chicken or falafel. The pita also works wonderfully for soaking up flavorful dressings and creating the perfect bite when combined with roasted vegetables and grains.
healthyChoice: At only 80 calories with 3g of protein and 1.5g of fat, the Side Quarter Pita is a health-conscious choice for adding substance to your meal. The sprouted wheat provides better nutrient bioavailability than conventional bread, offering more vitamins and minerals. Its modest carbohydrate content makes it suitable for balanced eating plans without derailing nutritional goals.
howToOrder: The Side Quarter Pita automatically comes included with any CAVA bowl order at no extra cost. Simply build your bowl with your choice of [CAVA Bases Menu](/menu/bases), proteins, and toppings, and your complimentary pita quarter will be added. If you prefer to skip it or want additional pita portions, inform the team during ordering.
vsAlternatives: Compared to the Whole Pita at 320 calories, the Side Quarter Pita offers portion control at exactly one-fourth the size and calories. While Classic Pita Chips provide 280 calories with a crunchy texture, the Side Quarter Pita delivers a soft, warm experience at just 80 calories. The flavored chip varieties cost $2.75 to $2.95, whereas the quarter pita is complimentary.
whoShouldTry: The Side Quarter Pita is perfect for anyone enjoying a CAVA bowl who wants a traditional Mediterranean bread element without excess calories. It suits diners seeking to add texture variety or those who love scooping their dips and spreads. Health-conscious customers and those exploring the [CAVA Nutrition Calculator](/calculator) will appreciate its light nutritional profile.
worthTrying: Absolutely worth including, especially since the Side Quarter Pita comes free with your bowl. Its sprouted wheat composition offers nutritional advantages, while the warm, soft texture enhances the Mediterranean dining experience. At zero additional cost and only 80 calories, there is little reason not to enjoy this wholesome, authentic side that complements virtually every bowl combination perfectly.

faqs.q: Is the Side Quarter Pita included free with every CAVA bowl?
faqs.a: Yes, the Side Quarter Pita is automatically included with any CAVA bowl at no additional charge. This complimentary 80-calorie addition provides a warm, sprouted wheat pita portion to enhance your meal without affecting the price.

faqs.q: What are the nutritional benefits of sprouted wheat pita?
faqs.a: Sprouted wheat pita offers increased nutrient bioavailability, making vitamins and minerals easier for your body to absorb. The sprouting process also breaks down complex starches and may improve digestibility compared to conventional pita bread, while providing wholesome energy at just 80 calories.

faqs.q: Can I get extra Side Quarter Pita portions or upgrade to a Whole Pita?
faqs.a: While one Side Quarter Pita comes complimentary with your bowl, you can upgrade to a Whole Pita for $2.25 to $2.55, which provides 320 calories. Ask the CAVA team about adding additional pita portions to your order based on your preferences.

faqs.q: What is the best way to enjoy the Side Quarter Pita?
faqs.a: The Side Quarter Pita works wonderfully for scooping dips and spreads like hummus, tzatziki, or crazy feta. You can also tear it into smaller pieces to combine with your bowl ingredients or use it to soak up flavorful dressings and sauces throughout your meal.

faqs.q: Is the Side Quarter Pita suitable for gluten-free diets?
faqs.a: No, the Side Quarter Pita contains sprouted wheat and is not suitable for gluten-free diets. For gluten-free options, consult the [CAVA Gluten Free Menu](/gluten-free) and [CAVA Allergen Menu](/allergen-menu) to find alternatives that meet your dietary requirements.
